subject: POC sprint gates, kickoff timing, and weekly readout plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@freshaio.com>
Cc: Tom Watson <tom.watson@freshaio.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-08-16T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & proposed POC sprint gates (kickoff, weekly check-ins, final readout)

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. I pulled together a concise plan for the 4-week POC we discussed so your team can review and confirm. High‑level goals: validate response latency & cost at expected query volumes, confirm fidelity on domain-specific prompts (support ticket summarization), and measure retrieval/embedding recall for your KB.

Proposed sprint gates (summary):
- Week 0 (kickoff): environment access, data mapping, success criteria sign-off
- Week 1–3 (execution): weekly demos + short readouts, baseline perf & model variant tests
- Week 4 (final readout): decision workshop, pass/fail against success criteria, optional extension items

Owners:
- Redwood tech lead / infra: Karthik Iyer (points: integration, VPC/credentials, model routing)
- Customer success & adoption: Marissa Cole (onboarding cadence, acceptance tests)
- Sales / commercial: Ben Carter (logistics, pricing follow-ups)

Next steps for your team (proposed):
1) Approve the success criteria below or provide edits by EOD Thursday.
2) Confirm preferred kickoff window: Aug 24–26 (we can do morning PST)
3) Share a scoped dataset sample or access method (S3/GCS) and any IP/PII redaction rules.

Draft success criteria (please adjust):
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 600ms for 512-token requests at 5 RPS sustained
- Accuracy/fidelity: automated rubric score >= 0.78 vs. sample hand labels
- Cost target: average token cost <= $0.003 (projected by Redwood tooling)
- Availability: no more than 1 outage >5 min during test window

Attachments: freshaio_poc_checklist_v1.xlsx (POC checklist), redwood-eval-metrics-template.csv (metrics template)

If that looks good I’ll lock the kickoff and share a calendar invite + mock runbook.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@freshaio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Watson <tom.watson@freshaio.com>, procurement@freshaio.com
Date: 2026-08-16T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed POC sprint gates (kickoff, weekly check-ins, final readout)

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap. Overall this maps to what we discussed. A few edits / notes from our side:

1) Success criteria edits:
  - For latency, can we target p95 <= 500ms if possible? Our UX team is sensitive to latency spikes. If that requires a different instance profile, flag it and we’ll evaluate cost tradeoffs.
  - For fidelity, we’ll add a qualitative pass: at least 1 SME (support manager) reviews 25% of generated summaries and marks them as "usable without edit."
2) Kickoff availability: Aug 25 morning PST works best (we prefer 10:00 am PST).
3) Data: Tom will provide a redacted S3 bucket link by Aug 20. Procurement copied to keep an eye on contracts/timing.

We reviewed the attachments and will return comments on the checklist by Tuesday. Also, can you share a short template of the weekly readout (what metrics + slides we should expect)?

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

—Elena
VP Product
FreshAI / FreshaIO
---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@freshaio.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-08-17T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed POC sprint gates (kickoff, weekly check-ins, final readout)

Hi Elena / team —

Thanks for the clarifications. A few operational notes from the infra/engineering side:

- p95 <= 500ms is achievable if we run the 2x RTX-6000 equivalent instance profile (we’ll call out the cost delta in the kickoff doc). I’ll include a short performance matrix in the runbook.
- Access: Please grant a read-only IAM role for the redwood-poc account to the S3 path (we prefer temporary credentials). If S3 is not available, we can accept a signed URL bundle.
- SME review: to operationalize this we’ll add a sampling hook in the evaluation harness; Marissa, can your team identify the SME and cadence (e.g., weekly sample of 50 summaries)?

Tentative owners & tasks before kickoff:
- Karthik: infra provisioning, performance matrix, runner config
- Marissa: weekly demo agenda + SME liaison
- Stephanie: evaluation harness config + metrics dashboard (we’ll pre-populate with the redwood-eval-metrics-template.csv)

I’ll produce a short technical checklist and a single-slide performance matrix and share by EOD Aug 19.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Elena —

Great — 10:00 am PST on Aug 25 is locked on my side. I’ll send a calendar invite with a 45-minute kickoff and attach the initial acceptance tests. Outline for kickoff:
- 10m welcome + goals
- 10m infra & access checklist (Karthik)
- 10m evaluation plan + metrics (Stephanie)
- 10m SME alignment + sample data (Elena/Tom)
- 5m next steps & schedule weekly demos

Weekly cadence: 30-minute demo + 15-minute blockers/ops on Wednesdays at 9:00 am PT starting Sep 1 (we can adjust after week 1). Final readout is Friday, Sep 24 (week 5) to allow buffer for any supplemental tests — tentatively 60 minutes.

Attachments: I attached an acceptance test workbook with a short checklist that maps to the success criteria you approved.

Marissa
